d: A satirical statue mocking Donald Trump’s Vietnam-era draft deferment has appeared on Washington’s National Mall. Titled “The Foot Soldier,” the monument references the bone spurs diagnosis Trump received during the Vietnam War, which helped him avoid military service. It features a plaque ridiculing his deferments and a quirky mascot called “Toey” – a six-foot-tall bone spur character. Organisers say the installation will remain near the National Gallery of Art Sculpture Garden until Veterans Day, adding a pointed political statement to the capital’s landscape.
